## Current PM

🟢 **`marchtian`** · session `session_016njDy8ozy9B9Ns5Y8kAWEK` · seated 2026-10-10T08:10Z on the maintainer's summon `/pm-dispatch spec@objectstack seat 2`. Writes go through the `fleet-write` relay as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; attribution is the session ID in the text.

- **Charter:** `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/spec.md`. **Terms:** `batch 3`, the default. Nothing carries over from the previous shift's terms (serial, 「不再派其他卡」); the maintainer has not restated them to this session.
- **Previous shift:** `os-sales` · `session_01DhTqaEHqPVSVnAkjG3jywn`, 2026-10-08T10:17Z to 2026-10-10T05:24Z. Its ledger is the body revision of 2026-10-10T05:23Z and its closing brief `6094189952`.

## Handover ledger

- **Inherited in flight:** none. The one handed-over item, #11509 / PR #22421, was taken over by `domain:spec` seat 1 (`os-tesla`) on the maintainer's word, claim `6095185086`. The seat-1 claim carries the predecessor's ACCEPT `6094161139`, the director's contract review PASS `6094261016` and the authorized APPROVED review forward.
- **Open items the previous shift left with the maintainer:**
  - #22222 needs a hosted cloud-tenant measurement that a seat session cannot take. It was reported in chat; no ruling is recorded.
  - One security finding from #22290's dev was reported off-thread. ⛔ It is not on GitHub.
- **Round 1** (in-session subagents, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus`; contract reviews by an isolated at-tier subagent, adopted by this seat). **Landed, 5:**
  - #22627 → PR #22673 `d973c34cdd`: the translated flow screen `title` / `description` / refusal `message` get the text-slot judge.
  - #22664 → PR #22688 `e04759d919`: error-code provenance reads a constant by its initializer; the ledger lists `@objectstack/mcp`'s exposure codes.
  - #22655 → PR #22714 `b6eb25f81a`: the `submitBehavior.url` docblock states the ruled contract and names no navigation mechanism.
  - #22682 items 1–2 → PR #22710 `b32ee3eaf3`: the approver `position` binding and the `position` decision output bind the position registry by name (ADR-0131 D4). Item 3 is `pm:on-hold` with `Restart-when:` = `PositionSchema` accepts `permissionSets` (#15204 stage 1).
  - #19939 pass 4 S1 → PR #22715 `f66fdc7973`: `subflow.input` / `map.input` / `script.inputs` are value slots. objectui companion card objectstack-ai/objectui#12101 (`pm:on-hold`); #22585 pointer posted.
- **Round 2** (same container, model and review route as round 1).
  - **Landed, 4:**
    - #22727 → PR #22733 `e86530088a`: `returnType` admits `currency`, and `@objectstack/formula` exports `inferFormulaReturn`. The skills edit was reverted out of the lane and filed as #22743 (`domain:skills`). objectui#12111 carries the renderer.
    - #22726 → PR #22749 `490cb6d9fa`: a write answer carries its advisory validation-rule hits as `warnings`. objectui#12107 carries the console.
    - #22754 → PR #22767 `e84aeb36ce`: `IWebhookService` (slot `webhooks`, optional `handleRedeliver`). Pointers went to #22755 and #22756; #22756 also carries the veto gap the review escalated.
    - #22301 item 6 → PR #22781 `a8f24b092c`: `stack.observeWrites(fn)` and `settled(match)`. Its carried needs C1 and C2 are recorded on the card and not filed.
  - **In the merge queue, 1:** #22725 → PR #22775 at `640aed576d`: the `unstaffed` arm of the approvals inbox read. ACCEPT `6106411772`. Patch round 1 corrected the contract's false `limit` docblock.
  - **Decided, 1:** #22636 went to a decision box. The maintainer ruled B (`6104584601`), and seat 1 landed it (PR #22762).
  - **Filed by this seat, 1:** #22782 (`bug`, `pm:queue`, awaiting triage). An `afterInsert` hook with the default `onError: 'abort'` that throws refuses the caller, but the row stays stored, because a plain write opens no transaction. That contradicts `HookSchema.onError`. The fork, between a transaction and a contract narrowing, is for the owning lane.
  - **In flight, 3:**
    - #22772 (claim `6105742415`): trigger-api segment 1, `ITriggerApiService` on slot `trigger-api`, PR #22779. The contract review passed at `6c636dca6e`. Patch round 1 (`6106448417`) narrows the docblock's "no oracle" security claim. A delta review follows the new head.
    - #22787 (claim `6106434946`): ADR-0139 E1, the `ReadableIds` branded comparand leaf. It is cross-lane to `packages/objectql/src/filter-comparand-shape.ts`. The window between E1 and E2 must fail closed.
    - #22301 item 7 (claim `6106527562`): a lowered-body door for the handle. `@objectstack/cli` depends on `@objectstack/verify`, so a reverse edge is a package-graph decision.
- **This seat's open cards now:**
  - #19939: `pm:dispatched`, stage owner. S2 is next after #22572 (seat 3, PR #22746) on the axis.
  - #22444: `pm:blocked`. Ruling C (`6100463199`): objectui#12099 lands first; then one objectstack PR moves `.objectui-sha` and lands the spec half.
  - #22222: `pm:awaiting-maintainer` (a hosted-tenant reading no seat can take).
  - #22725, #22772, #22787, #22301: above.
- **Handed to other seats this round:**
  - #22682 item 3: restarted to `pm:queue` (`6105803819`). Seat 1 claimed it, and it is now `pm:blocked` on objectui#12126.
  - #22759: seat 3.
- **Cross-repo ledger:**
  - hotcrm's sites at #19939's value-slot positions are NOT MEASURED. A census is owed before S1–S6 reach hotcrm, by a seat that can read hotcrm.
  - hotcrm can retire `recordEngineWrites` onto `observeWrites` once it takes a release carrying #22781. A gap found there carries C1 and C2.
  - objectui designer: objectstack-ai/objectui#12101 carries S1, and later stages comment on it.
  - objectui#7611 C9 follow-up owes `decisionOutputParams` and `escalateTo` (from #22682). It lands with objectui's v18 spec bump and before #15204 stage 8.
  - objectui#12111 (the currency formula renderer) and objectui#12107 (the console shows `warnings`) unblock when a spec release carries those keys. So does objectui#12102 (`unstaffed` in the `awaiting_me` scope and the bell), once #22725 lands.
- **Housekeeping for a person:** a stray root-owned `/suite.pid` (6 bytes) sits at this seat container's root. The harness refused its removal, so the maintainer was told.

## Hot-file serial queue

⛔ Re-derive this from the live `Claim:` comments and each open PR's actual file list before every dispatch.

- **This seat's claims:**
  - #22772: `packages/spec/src/contracts/trigger-api-service.ts`, `contracts/index.ts`, and `api-surface` / `export-origins` `contracts.json`.
  - #22787: `packages/spec/src/data/` (the new leaf plus the data barrel), `api-surface` / `export-origins` data artifacts, and `packages/objectql/src/filter-comparand-shape.ts` (cross-lane).
  - #22301 item 7: `packages/verify/**`, and `packages/cli/src/utils/lower-callables.ts` / `extract-hook-body.ts` only if measured necessary.
  - #22725 (queued): `contracts/approval-service.ts`, `plugin-approvals`, `rest-server.ts`.
- **Other seats on this lane's hot files:** #22572 (seat 3, PR #22746): `automation/builtin-node-config.zod.ts`, `control-flow.zod.ts`, `flow.zod.ts` and `flow-bound-variable-name.*`.
- **Known serial edges:**
  - `contracts/index.ts` and `contracts.json` take one new contract at a time. A merge regenerates them with the generators, never by hand. The os-regen driver once dropped a sibling line, and the generators restored it.
  - `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`, `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` (`STEP18_RATIONALE`): the v18 train's shared hot spots.
    - A `STEP18_RATIONALE` conflict resolves as the verbatim union of both sides, in id order.
    - A generated file goes through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`.
  - `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`: one key addition at a time.
  - `area:workflow` / `builtin-node-config.zod.ts`: #19939 S1 (landed) → #22677 (closed) → #22572 (seat 3, PR #22746) → #19939 S2 → S3 → S4 → S5 → S6 → S7 (`6096263424`).

- **Review posture this round:** a contract review that finds a false sentence in the contract text a PR edits becomes a text-only patch round in that PR. It is not carried. Applied on #22725 (`limit`) and #22772 ("no oracle").
